name: get_task
title: Get a task
description: Get a task: description, stage, status, assignee, labels, links, relations, theme (with its cards), parent, subtasks, attachments (open with read_attachment) and recent timeline. A long description comes in parts and a long timeline text is cut; the result says how to read the rest.

event_id.description: Id of a timeline event: returns its whole text. Only when a timeline line is cut.

description_offset.description: Show the description from this character on (default 0), when get_task said it is cut.
